test_code:
import pytest
from main import update_account_balance

test_cases = [
    (0, 100, 100),
    (100, 200, 300),
]

validation_cases = [
    pytest.param(0, 0, 0, marks=pytest.mark.validate),
    pytest.param(4500, 50, 4550, marks=pytest.mark.validate),
]

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input1", "input2", "expected_output"), test_cases + validation_cases
)
def test_update_account_balance(input1, input2, expected_output):
    print("\n---------------------------------")
    print(f"Inputs: {input1}, {input2}")
    result = update_account_balance(input1, input2)
    print(f"Expected: {expected_output}")
    print(f"Actual:   {result}")
    assert result == expected_output
solution_code:
def update_account_balance(current_balance: int, deposit: int) -> int:
    return current_balance + deposit
